rows.english: Vegetables and staples alongside fruit, nuts and berries. Ten-year projection; not a harvest promise.
rows.zu: Imifino nokudla okuyisisekelo kanye nezithelo, amantongomane namabheri. Isilinganiso seminyaka eyishumi; akusona isithembiso sesivuno.
rows.st: Meroho le dijalo tsa motheo hammoho le ditholwana, linate le monokotshwai. Ponelopele ya dilemo tse leshome; ha se tshepiso ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka swin’we ni mihandzu, timanga ni mabyerisi. Mvhumbo wa khume ra malembe; a hi xitshembiso xa ntshovelo.
rows.ve: Miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo khathihi na mitshelo, nḓuhu na maberi. Mbonelaphanḓa ya miṅwaha ya fumi; a si fulufhedziso ḽa khaṋo.

rows.english: Green = vegetable and staple crop cycles. Gold = your tree yield schedule. Striped ends show harvest that changes as plants age during the year. * = known subtotal only; missing yields are not zero.
rows.zu: Okuluhlaza = imijikelezo yemifino nokudla okuyisisekelo. Okusagolide = uhlelo lwakho lwesivuno sezihlahla. Iziphetho ezinemithende zibonisa isivuno esishintshayo njengoba izitshalo zikhula phakathi nonyaka. * = isamba esincane esaziwayo kuphela; izivuno ezingekho aziwona uziro.
rows.st: Botala = medikoloho ya meroho le dijalo tsa motheo. Mmala wa kgauta = lenane la hao la kotulo ya difate. Dipheletso tse metsero di bontsha kotulo e fetohang ha dimela di hola selemong. * = kakaretso e tsejwang feela; dikotulo tse siyo ha se lefela.
rows.ts: Rihlaza = mindzhendzheleko ya matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka. Nsuku = nongonoko wa wena wa ntshovelo wa mirhi. Makumu lama nga ni tilayini ma komba ntshovelo lowu cincaka loko swimila swi kula elembeni. * = nhlayo leyitsongo leyi tivekaka ntsena; mintshovelo leyi kayivelaka a hi ziro.
rows.ve: Mudala = mutevhe ya miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo. Musuku = mbekanyamushumo yaṋu ya khaṋo ya miri. Magumo a re na mitalo a sumbedza khaṋo ine ya shanduka musi zwimela zwi tshi aluwa kha ṅwaha. * = tshivhalo tshiṱuku tshi ḓivheaho fhedzi; khaṋo dzi siho a si zero.

rows.english: Projection, not a harvest promise. Vegetables and staples repeat only saved recurring sowings; dated and existing crops happen once.
rows.zu: Isilinganiso, hhayi isithembiso sesivuno. Imifino nokudla okuyisisekelo kuphinda kuphela ukuhlwanyela okuphindwayo okugcinwe ohlelweni; izitshalo ezinezinsuku nezikhona zenzeka kanye.
rows.st: Ponelopele, eseng tshepiso ya kotulo. Meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di pheta feela ho jala ho iphetang ho bolokilweng; dijalo tse nang le matsatsi le tse seng di le teng di etsahala hang feela.
rows.ts: Mvhumbo, ku nga ri xitshembiso xa ntshovelo. Matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka swi phinda ntsena ku byala loku phindhaka loku hlayisiweke; swibyariwa leswi nga ni masiku ni leswi nga kona swi humelela kan’we ntsena.
rows.ve: Mbonelaphanḓa, hu si fulufhedziso ḽa khaṋo. Miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo zwi dovholola u zwala hu dovhololaho ho vhulungwaho fhedzi; zwiliṅwa zwi re na maḓuvha na zwi re hone zwi itea luthihi.

rows.english: Vegetable and staple crop-cycle kilograms are counted in the year of first picking, not divided into monthly quantities. Carry-in harvests need actual records.
rows.zu: Amakhilogremu omjikelezo wemifino nokudla okuyisisekelo abalwa ngonyaka wokuqala wokuvuna, awahlukaniswa abe amanani enyanga. Izivuno eziqale ngaphambi konyaka zidinga amarekhodi angempela.
rows.st: Dikhilograma tsa potoloho ya meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di balwa selemong sa ho qala kotulo, ha di arolwe ka bongata ba dikgwedi. Dikotulo tse qalileng pele ho selemo di hloka direkoto tsa nnete.
rows.ts: Tikhilogiramu ta ndzhendzheleko wa matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka ti hlayiwa elembeni ro sungula ku tshovela, a ti avanyisiwi hi tinhlayo ta tin’hweti. Mintshovelo leyi sunguleke lembe ri nga si fika yi lava tirhekhodo ta xiviri.
rows.ve: Khilogiramu dza mutevhe wa miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo dzi vhalwa kha ṅwaha wa u thoma u kaṋa, a dzi kovhekanywi nga zwivhalo zwa miṅwedzi. Khaṋo dzo thomaho ṅwaha u sa athu u thoma dzi ṱoḓa rekhodo dza vhukuma.

rows.english: Vegetable and staple estimates hold bed area, sowings and crop benchmarks constant. Revise the plan if growing trees change shade, water or available bed space.
rows.zu: Izilinganiso zemifino nokudla okuyisisekelo zigcina indawo yombhede, ukuhlwanyela namazinga okuqhathanisa ezitshalo kungashintshi. Buyekeza uhlelo uma izihlahla ezikhulayo zishintsha umthunzi, amanzi noma indawo yombhede etholakalayo.
rows.st: Dikakanyo tsa meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di boloka sebaka sa bethe, ho jala le ditekanyetso tsa dijalo di sa fetohe. Fetola moralo haeba difate tse holang di fetola moriti, metsi kapa sebaka sa bethe se teng.
rows.ts: Swiringanyeto swa matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka swi hlayisa ndhawu ya mubedo, ku byala ni mimpimo ya swibyariwa swi nga cinci. Pfuxeta kungu loko mirhi leyi kulaka yi cinca ndzhuti, mati kumbe ndhawu ya mubedo leyi kumekaka.
rows.ve: Ndumbedzo dza miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo dzi vhulunga fhethu ha mubete, u zwala na mimpimo ya zwiliṅwa zwi sa shanduki. Vusuludzani pulane arali miri i aluwaho ya shandula murunzi, maḓi kana fhethu ha mubete hu re hone.

rows.english: Tree ages run from planting on this site. Separate older and younger plants into age groups. Research first-crop ages are references, not guaranteed dates.
rows.zu: Iminyaka yezihlahla iqala lapho zitshalwa kule ndawo. Hlukanisa izitshalo ezindala nezincane ngamaqembu eminyaka. Iminyaka yesivuno sokuqala yocwaningo iyizinkomba, hhayi izinsuku eziqinisekisiwe.
rows.st: Dilemo tsa difate di qala ha di lengwa sebakeng sena. Arola dimela tse kgolo le tse nyane ka dihlopha tsa dilemo. Dilemo tsa kotulo ya pele tsa dipatlisiso ke ditshupiso, eseng matsatsi a tiisitsweng.
rows.ts: Malembe ya mirhi ma sungula loko yi byariwa endhawini leyi. Avanyisa swimila swa khale ni leswintshwa hi mintlawa ya vukhale. Malembe ya ntshovelo wo sungula ya ndzavisiso i swisekelo, ku nga ri masiku lama tiyisisiweke.
rows.ve: Miṅwaha ya miri i thoma musi i tshi ṱavhiwa kha fhethu afha. Fhandekanyani zwimela zwihulwane na zwiṱuku nga zwigwada zwa miṅwaha. Miṅwaha ya khaṋo ya u thoma ya ṱhoḓisiso ndi zwisumbedzi, hu si maḓuvha o khwaṱhisedzwaho.

rows.english: Tree kg are your farm or nursery assumptions per plant per year. Values hold until the next age you enter; no growth multiplier is invented. A range covers changes within the year. Review the schedule as plants age.
rows.zu: Ama-kg ezihlahla ayizilinganiso zepulazi lakho noma zenkulisa ngesitshalo ngonyaka. Amanani ahlala enjalo kuze kufike iminyaka elandelayo oyifakayo; akukho siphindaphindi sokukhula esisunguliwe. Ibanga lihlanganisa ushintsho phakathi nonyaka. Buyekeza uhlelo njengoba izitshalo zikhula.
rows.st: Kg tsa difate ke dikakanyo tsa polasi ya hao kapa tsa sebaka sa ho hodisa dimela ka semela ka selemo. Ditekanyo di dula jwalo ho fihlela dilemong tse latelang tseo o di kenyang; ha ho qapwe tekanyo e atisang kgolo. Moedi o akaretsa diphetoho selemong. Hlahloba lenane ha dimela di hola.
rows.ts: Kg ta mirhi i swiringanyeto swa purasi ra wena kumbe ndhawu yo kurisa swimila hi ximilana hi lembe. Mimpimo yi tshamisa xisweswo ku fika eka vukhale byin’wana u byi nghenisaka; a ku tumbuluxiwi mpimo wo andzisa ku kula. Mpimo wo suka eka wun’wana ku ya eka wun’wana wu katsa ku cinca endzeni ka lembe. Kambisisa nongonoko loko swimila swi kula.
rows.ve: Kg dza miri ndi ndumbedzo dza bulasi ḽaṋu kana dza fhethu ha u alusa zwimela nga tshimela nga ṅwaha. Mimpimo i dzula yo ralo u swika kha miṅwaha i tevhelaho ine na i dzhenisa; a hu vhumbiwi mpimo wa u andisa nyaluwo. Mukano u katela tshanduko dza kha ṅwaha. Sedzulusani mbekanyamushumo musi zwimela zwi tshi aluwa.

rows.english: Check that the variety, local climate, pollination, water and care match your yield assumptions. Ages alone do not establish site suitability or survival.
rows.zu: Hlola ukuthi uhlobo, isimo sezulu sendawo, impova, amanzi nokunakekela kuhambisana nezilinganiso zakho zesivuno. Iminyaka iyodwa ayiqinisekisi ukufaneleka kwendawo noma ukusinda.
rows.st: Hlahloba hore mofuta, tlelaemete ya sebaka, ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya palesa, metsi le tlhokomelo di dumellana le dikakanyo tsa hao tsa kotulo. Dilemo feela ha di tiise ho tshwaneleha ha sebaka kapa ho phela ha dimela.
rows.ts: Kambela leswaku muxaka, maxelo ya ndhawu, ku hangalasiwa ka mpova, mati ni nhlayiso swi fambelana ni swiringanyeto swa wena swa ntshovelo. Vukhale ntsena a byi tiyisisi ku faneleka ka ndhawu kumbe ku hanya.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani uri lushaka, kilima ya henefho, u phaḓaladza luvhanda, maḓi na ṱhogomelo zwi anḓana na ndumbedzo dzaṋu dza khaṋo. Miṅwaha fhedzi a i khwaṱhisedzi u tea ha fhethu kana u tshila.

rows.english: Known subtotals leave out missing yields. Eggs, meat, milk, fish and honey are not included in these crop kg totals. Picking months and food-gap checks still need local confirmation.
rows.zu: Izamba ezincane ezaziwayo zishiya ngaphandle izivuno ezingekho. Amaqanda, inyama, ubisi, izinhlanzi noju akufakwa kulezi zamba zama-kg ezitshalo. Izinyanga zokuvuna nokuhlola izikhala zokudla kusadinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni.
rows.st: Dikakaretso tse tsejwang di siya dikotulo tse siyo kantle. Mahe, nama, lebese, ditlhapi le mahe a dinotshi ha di kenyeletswe dikakaretsong tsena tsa kg tsa dijalo. Dikgwedi tsa kotulo le ditlhahlobo tsa dikgeo tsa dijo di sa hloka netefatso sebakeng seo.
rows.ts: Tinhlayo letitsongo leti tivekaka a ti katsi mintshovelo leyi kayivelaka. Matandza, nyama, ntswamba, tihlampfi ni vulombe a swi katsiwanga eka tinhlayo leti ta kg ta swibyariwa. Tin’hweti ta ntshovelo ni ku kambela mavangwa ya swakudya swa ha lava ku tiyisisiwa endhawini.
rows.ve: Zwivhalo zwiṱuku zwi ḓivheaho a zwi kateli khaṋo dzi siho. Makumba, ṋama, mafhi, khovhe na mutoli a zwi katelwi kha zwivhalo izwi zwa kg dza zwiliṅwa. Miṅwedzi ya u kaṋa na u ṱola zwikhala zwa zwiḽiwa zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa khwaṱhisedzo ya henefho.

rows.english: Each column covers twelve months. Species total = all mapped plants. Group rows give kg for that age group. ? = missing information.
rows.zu: Ikholomu ngayinye ihlanganisa izinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Isamba sohlobo = zonke izitshalo ezisebalazweni. Imigqa yamaqembu inikeza ama-kg alelo qembu leminyaka. ? = ulwazi olungekho.
rows.st: Kholomo ka nngwe e akaretsa dikgwedi tse leshome le metso e mmedi. Kakaretso ya mofuta = dimela tsohle tse mmapeng. Mela ya dihlopha e fana ka kg tsa sehlopha seo sa dilemo. ? = tlhahisoleseding e siyo.
rows.ts: Kholomu yin’wana ni yin’wana yi katsa tin’hweti ta khume na timbirhi. Nhlayo ya muxaka = swimila hinkwato swa le mepeni. Tilayini ta mintlawa ti nyika kg ta ntlawa wolowo wa vukhale. ? = vuxokoxoko byo kayivela.
rows.ve: Kholomu iṅwe na iṅwe i katela miṅwedzi ya fumi-mbili. Tshivhalo tsha lushaka = zwimela zwoṱhe zwi re kha mapa. Mitalo ya zwigwada i ṋea kg dza tshigwada tshenetsho tsha miṅwaha. ? = mafhungo a siho.
